name: sat_clipper_parallel
description: Soft clipper in parallel — adds presence, density, and upper harmonic content
notes: Hard cubic clipper at drive 0.5 produces strong odd harmonics (3rd, 5th) that add presence and aggression. At 20% wet the effect is subtle but audible: the mix gains density and edge without sounding distorted. Classic trick on snare or the full mix. Higher mix values (0.3-0.4) give audible grit — use on parallel snare or drum bus.
